preset.description: Optional starter preset merged before explicit config values.

defaultTheme.description: Initial theme mode used by generated CSS and runtime helpers. Use system to follow prefers-color-scheme until the app stores a user choice.

method.description: Palette generation strategy. analogous is shade-driven and uses generated shades for background, surface, border, and action tokens. monochromatic is canvas-driven: light mode uses a strict white canvas, dark mode uses a strict black canvas, color-primary-bg and color-secondary-bg stay equal to the configured colors, and shade 50/950 are forced to #ffffff/#000000. glass keeps shade-driven action colors but makes surfaces and borders translucent with a shared backdrop-filter token.

fixShade.description: When true, generates interior shades from shade 500 so the source color controls the middle of the ramp. When false, places the source color at its nearest lightness shade.

unit.description: Single base unit in pixels used to derive spacing, control sizes, radii, typography, focus width, and blur unless those values are explicitly configured.

shadow.description: Shadow intensity multiplier. Use 0 to remove theme shadows, values below 1 for quieter shadows, and values above 1 for stronger elevation.

border.description: Border width multiplier in pixels. Use 0 to remove token-driven borders, fractional values for hairline borders, and values above 1 for stronger outlines.

density.description: Global density scale for generated spacing and control sizes.

motion.description: Motion duration multiplier. Use 0 for instant transitions.

blur.description: Glass surface blur amount in pixels.

glassAlpha.description: Glass chrome background opacity as a 0-1 ratio. Lower values reveal more backdrop color through AppBar and similar translucent chrome surfaces.

controlRadius.description: Radius in pixels for buttons, inputs, chips, and controls.

surfaceRadius.description: Radius in pixels for cards, panels, dialogs, and surfaces.

textFontFamily.description: Font stack for body copy, labels, controls, and normal text. Falls back to fontFamily.

headingFontFamily.description: Font stack for h1-h6 text and title-like component labels. Falls back to fontFamily.

hoverLift.description: Vertical hover lift in pixels for interactive controls.

hoverShadow.description: Opacity for hover shadow emphasis as a 0-1 ratio.

activeScale.description: Scale used by pressed interactive controls.

focusAlpha.description: Alpha used when rendering focus rings from the focus color.

transition.description: Transition duration multiplier for interactive components.

viewport.description: Root font-size strategy. Fixed avoids viewport-wide rem invalidation, fluid scales continuously, and stepped changes only at configured breakpoints.

strategy.description: Root font-size behavior. Defaults to fixed when viewport is omitted. Existing viewport objects without strategy retain fluid behavior.

rootMin.description: Minimum root font size in pixels.

rootMax.description: Maximum root font size in pixels.

minWidth.description: Viewport width in pixels where rootMin is reached.

maxWidth.description: Viewport width in pixels where rootMax is reached.

breakpoints.description: Mobile-first min-width breakpoints used by responsive component props and shared SCSS helpers.
